label: AC-20(2)
title: Portable Storage Devices — Restricted Use

statement.prose: Restrict the use of organization-controlled portable storage devices by authorized individuals on external systems using {{ insert: param, ac-20.02_odp }}.

guidance: Limits on the use of organization-controlled portable storage devices in external systems include restrictions on how the devices may be used and under what conditions the devices may be used.

params.label: restrictions
guidelines: restrictions on the use of organization-controlled portable storage devices by authorized individuals on external systems are defined;
